checkpoints.title: Embedded, checked seed of synthetic Example Co plan passages
contracts: store.Load/Parse: seed v1 {version, synthetic, employer, plan_year, passages[{id, plan, section, text}]}; refuses non-synthetic seeds, malformed or duplicate IDs, empty fields, and non-example.com email addresses
instrumentation: Parse errors wrap ErrSeed and name the passage
checkpoints.rollback: The seed is embedded read-only data with no migration: revert the commit (git revert) and rebuild; nothing persisted outside the binary changes
